contributions.title: Instructions and skills
contributions.description: Up to 64 text contributions. Each needs a unique ID, version and non-empty content.

id.title: Contribution ID
id.description: Stable identifier, unique within this list.

version.title: Version
version.description: Revision label for this contribution, up to 64 bytes.

kind.title: Contribution type
kind.description: Publish this text as an instruction or a skill.

content.title: Content
content.description: Instruction or skill text, up to 65,536 UTF-8 bytes (64 KiB). Line breaks are preserved.
